title: THREAT Matrix per-release ID manifest
description: Per-release inventory of every identifier a framework content release carries, introduced with schema 3.0.0. One manifest ships per release as docs/data/id-manifest-<version>.json, produced by scripts/lint/id-manifest.py from framework.json. Comparing consecutive manifests audits the docs/IDENTIFIERS.md guarantee that identifiers are never reused or silently dropped: an ID present in release N must appear in release N+1, either in its namespace list or in reserved. Namespace lists carry every active, deprecated, and superseded ID; reserved carries every ID whose lifecycle_state is reserved, from any namespace. Each list is sorted and free of duplicates.

version.description: Framework content version (framework.json version) this manifest inventories.

generated.description: UTC timestamp (ISO 8601, second precision, Z suffix) at which the manifest was generated.

reserved.description: IDs from any namespace whose lifecycle_state is reserved. A reserved ID never also appears in its namespace list.
